text:
Sizing fix: the gain sign was wrong because of feedforward through the feedback resistor, so this edit keeps the topology and re-sizes the feedback network.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Positive gain: Rf≈1.4k is below 1/gm≈2.3k, so feedforward through Rf dominates. Make Rf large (tens of kΩ) and set R1≈Rf/0.007. Pre-compensate with an exact formula that includes feedforward. Push tail current to the power limit and use short L so f_u≥300 MHz at beta≈1."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (17.0, 11.0, 23.0),
    "L_in":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),
    "L_p":     (0.25, 0.15, 0.8),
    "gmid_t":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Itail":   (64e-6, 30e-6, 66e-6),
    "Rf":      (40e3, 10e3, 150e3),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    g = 0.007
    pmax = 140e-6
    itail = min(p["Itail"], 0.97 * pmax / vdd - iref)
    itail = max(itail, 5e-6)
    ih = itail / 2

    vtail = 0.3
    vout_dc = 0.9
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=vout_dc - vtail, vsb=vtail)
    m_ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], ih, vds=0.85)
    m_t = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], itail, vds=vtail)
    m_bd = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m_bd = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=m_bd.vgs)

    Rf = p["Rf"]
    go = m_in.gds + m_ld.gds
    # effective inverting gain incl. feedforward through Rf
    Ap = (m_in.gm - 1.0 / Rf) / (go + 1.0 / Rf)
    # closed loop: a1 = -Ap*Rf/(R1 + Rf + Ap*R1)  -> solve R1
    R1 = Rf * (Ap - g) / (g * (1.0 + Ap))
    a1 = -Ap * Rf / (R1 + Rf + Ap * R1)
    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_bd)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_t)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vx", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vx", R1)
    n.R("RF", "vx", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    cout = cl + m_in.cdd + m_ld.cdd + m_in.cgd + m_ld.cgd
    f_u = m_in.gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    rx = Rf * R1 / (Rf + R1)
    p_vx = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rx * (m_in.cgg + 2e-15))
    p_mir = m_ld.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m_ld.cgg + m_in.cdd + m_ld.cdd))
    bw = beta * f_u
    bw = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1.0 / bw**2 + 0.5 / p_vx**2 + 0.25 / p_mir**2)
    dv = (vdd - m_ld.vgs) - vout_dc
    vos = (m_ld.gds * dv) / m_in.gm
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": vos / beta,
               "power": power, "loop_gain_db": db(max(Ap * beta, 1e-9))}
```
